mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE r.status = 1

, all_role_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE r.status = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN all_role_ids ar ON rp.role_id = ar.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE p.status = 1
